# Exercise debrief: scn-9001-contained

## Outcome
Exercise over: the defender contained the intruder on willow. The protected file was never read.

Detection delay: 13 moves.
Containment move: isolated willow (evt-0007).

## Timeline
- **First probe** (evt-0004): The intruder asked upland for /admin/status (evt-0004).
- **First alert** (evt-0005): 1 sensor alert was showing on the defender turn, highest high (evt-0005).
- **First sign-in** (evt-0006): The intruder signed in to willow as runner (evt-0006).
- **Containment** (evt-0007): The defender isolated willow (evt-0007). That came 1 move after the sign-in (evt-0006 to evt-0007).
- **Read blocked** (evt-0010): The intruder could not reach the protected file after containment (evt-0010).
- **Detection** (evt-0015): Detection came 13 moves after the first intruder move (evt-0002 to evt-0015).

## What the defender did well
- The defender contained the signed-in host within 1 move of the sign-in. (evt-0006, evt-0007)
- The defender reported the intrusion 13 moves after the first intruder move. (evt-0002, evt-0015)
- The defender checked host logs before acting. (evt-0003, evt-0007)
- The defender acted on sensor alert evidence. (evt-0007, evt-0015)
- The protected file stayed unread even after a sign-in. (evt-0006, evt-0007)

## Weaknesses and recommendations
- Detection took 13 moves after the first intruder move. (evt-0002, evt-0015)
  Recommendation: Check entry host logs on every defender turn so probing is seen sooner.
- A guessed password opened willow as runner. (evt-0006)
  Recommendation: Rotate the willow password and slow repeated bad guesses.
- The open admin page on upland stayed open through the exercise. (evt-0004, evt-0031)
  Recommendation: Patch the exposed page as soon as probing shows.
- willow stayed down at the end of the exercise. (evt-0007)
  Recommendation: Restore each host after patching to limit downtime.

_Layer 1 report, derived from the exercise log with no model. All event ids cite the exercise log._
